answer: A tier-3 answer must contain at least 7 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. A farm padding one paragraph as a result cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, since length is not what is counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
